question: 6061-T6 thermal conductivity value compared to T4 state

sources.title: 6061 Aluminum Thermal Conductivity: T4 vs T6 and Unit Conversions
sources.snippet: 6061 Aluminum Thermal Conductivity: T4 vs T6 At about 20°C (68°F), Kaiser lists typical thermal conductivity of 154 W/ (m·K) for 6061-T4/T451 and 167 W/ (m·K) for 6061-T6/T651. T6 is about 8.4% higher in this dataset. These are useful preliminary design values, not guaranteed minimums or proof that a finished heat sink will run 8.4% cooler.
